report_name: Dutch Regulator Warns Financial Firms of Growing AI and Cyber Risks

identities.name: Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM)
identities.description: The Netherlands' financial conduct regulator, which published a report on November 9, 2026, warning the financial sector about increasing risks from AI adoption and reliance on third-party IT services.

identities.name: Financial service providers in the Netherlands
identities.description: The class of organizations, including banks, investment firms, and insurance companies, to which the AFM's warning on AI and third-party IT risks is addressed.
